description: Pass 2 of LUMEN - 'eight kinds of light'. Each keyframe painted by LumenStills.json becomes the first frame of a five-second MiniMax-H3 shot (fl2va, first frame pinned), generated fresh from its still so no shot inherits another's drift. The eight shots are cut together and the unbroken Music3 score is laid over the whole edit, frame-exact by construction: 8 x 124 frames at 24 fps against a 992-frame slice of the track.

variables.shot_1_dawn_lake:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action nature cinematography. The shot opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a wide view across a mirror-calm alpine lake at dawn, jagged snow-capped granite peaks glowing pink and gold at their summits while the valley floor rests in cool blue shadow, thin veils of mist lying low over the water, dark boulders and a weathered wooden jetty in the foreground. The mist drifts slowly from left to right and thins as the light grows, the alpenglow on the summits brightening from pink toward gold and creeping a little further down the rock faces, while the reflection in the lake stays sharp and undisturbed except for a single slow ring spreading from a fish rising near the jetty. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the far peaks throughout, holding the jetty at the bottom of frame.

overall_soundscape: A hushed, wide open-air room tone at altitude: near-total stillness, a faint whisper of cold air, the soft lap of water against the jetty piles, one distant bird call echoing off the rock walls.

non_diegetic_music: None.

For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action nature cinematography. The shot opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a wide view across a golden barley field at morning golden hour, backlit so every head of grain glows, a single ancient oak standing on a low rise, drifting seed fluff and dust lit up against the hazy blue ridge beyond. A long slow gust moves across the field from the far left to the near right, bending the barley in a broad travelling wave that catches the backlight as it passes, the seed fluff and dust swirling upward and glowing in the sun, the oak's leaves shivering as the gust reaches it, then the field settling back as a second gentler wave follows. The camera trucks right at slow speed through the whole shot, the nearest stalks sliding past in the foreground.

overall_soundscape: Warm morning air with the continuous soft hiss and rustle of dry barley heads brushing each other in the wind, rising and falling with each gust, the leaves of the distant oak whispering, a skylark singing somewhere high overhead.

non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action nature cinematography. The shot opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a low angle inside an old-growth redwood forest, thick shafts of sunlight cutting through morning fog between enormous russet trunks, sword ferns and moss on the forest floor and a small clear creek in the foreground, pollen glowing in the beams. The fog drifts slowly through the trunks so the sunbeams brighten, fade and shift across the ferns, motes of pollen floating and turning inside the light, the creek rippling gently over its stones, a fern frond nodding as a drop of water falls from it. The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed from the creek toward the high canopy where the beams originate, the trunks rising past the edges of frame.

overall_soundscape: A deep, still forest room tone with the close burble of the small creek over stones, occasional drips of condensation falling onto ferns, a soft breath of wind high in the canopy, and the calls of small birds far off among the trees.

non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action nature cinematography. The shot opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a tall waterfall plunging into a green plunge pool inside a black basalt canyon, a full bright rainbow arcing through the drifting spray, wet dark rock and vivid moss lit by midday sun. The water pours continuously down the face in heavy white ropes, exploding into mist at the base, the spray cloud billowing and drifting so the rainbow strengthens and softens as the mist thickens and thins, ripples spreading across the plunge pool and small rivulets streaming off the mossy ledges. The camera pedestals down with small amplitude at slow speed from the lip of the falls toward the pool, keeping the rainbow inside the frame.

overall_soundscape: The full continuous roar of a large waterfall filling the canyon, deep and enveloping, with the hiss of fine spray closer to the camera, water slapping and churning in the plunge pool and the trickle of rivulets over the mossy rock.

non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action nature cinematography. The shot opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a wide view over vast rippled sand dunes at sunset, the knife-edge crest of the nearest dune lit warm orange against deep violet shadow, fine sand streaming off the ridge in the wind, ranks of dunes fading into golden haze toward the horizon. A steady wind lifts a continuous ribbon of fine sand off the crest that curls and glitters in the low sun before falling into the shadowed slope, small grains skittering across the ripples in the foreground, and the light deepening slowly from orange toward red as the sun drops. The camera pans right at slow speed along the length of the crest, the sunlit face and shadowed face of the dune sliding past together.

overall_soundscape: A dry, wide desert wind, steady and low, with the fine granular hiss of sand grains streaming over the crest and skittering across the ripples, and nothing else for miles.

non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action nature cinematography. The shot opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a wide view of thousands of glowing paper sky lanterns rising into a deep blue twilight sky above a calm river, their warm reflections shimmering on the water, a wooden boat and the silhouettes of a riverside village and a pagoda. The lanterns drift slowly upward and gently sideways as a mass, each one flickering softly and turning as its flame breathes, new lanterns lifting from the riverbank to join them, their reflections wobbling and stretching on the small ripples of the water, the boat rocking very slightly. The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed from the river toward the densest part of the rising swarm.

overall_soundscape: A soft, festive evening: the distant murmur of a crowd on the riverbank, the papery flutter and faint crackle of hundreds of lantern flames, water lapping against the boat's hull, and a far-off temple bell struck once.

non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action nature cinematography. The shot opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a tropical beach at night, waves breaking in glowing electric-blue bioluminescence on dark wet sand, the Milky Way blazing across the sky, silhouettes of palm trees at the edges of the frame. Wave after wave rolls in and breaks, each crest flaring bright cyan as it tumbles and the foam spreading up the sand as glowing blue lace before sliding back and fading, the wet sand holding a faint afterglow where the water has been, the palm fronds swaying gently, the stars steady and sharp overhead. The camera holds a static wide shot throughout.

overall_soundscape: The slow rhythmic wash of tropical surf: each wave building, breaking with a soft hush and rush, sizzling foam spreading up the sand and draining back, palm fronds rustling gently in a warm night breeze, and distant crickets.

non_diegetic_music: None.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action nature cinematography. The shot opens exactly on <Picture 1>: a wide view of a vivid aurora borealis in green, violet and magenta curtains over a frozen lake whose glass-clear black ice reflects the whole sky, snow-dusted mountains on the horizon, one lone dark pine at the shore, stars between the curtains. The aurora ripples and folds slowly across the sky like a curtain in a draught, brightening in slow pulses, the green rays sharpening and streaming upward while the violet and magenta fringes drift along their lower edges, every movement mirrored in the ice below, a light drift of snow blowing low across the surface past the pine. The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed from the reflected sky in the ice toward the brightest curtain overhead, ending on the sky.

overall_soundscape: A vast frozen silence under the aurora: a faint low wind moving snow across the ice, the deep occasional creak and boom of the lake ice settling, and nothing else.

non_diegetic_music: None.
